auth.summary: Who is using the app. The Kernel owns accounts and sessions; the app only reads the current one.

options.label: Who can create an account
options.help: Choose who may create an app account. Allowlist entries stay as separate email addresses or domains.

options.label: Sign-in methods
options.help: Password stays on. Google needs this app's Google client set as signing secrets.

actions.summary: The only door to the database. A call names a Server Action declared in actions.json and passes its input; the Kernel authorizes the caller, binds the input and runs the action's one SQL statement, or records its Signal.

files.summary: Small files stored by the Kernel for one Deployment. The module option can require an app session to read every file.

options.label: Who can read every file
options.help: Let every signed-in user read all files in this app.

calls.summary: Calls from this app to another app or an outside service, made by the Kernel from its own process, never from the browser. There is no browser call: the page invokes the call action with miniapp.actions.call, which answers { callId, queued: true }, and the Kernel sends the request, retries it and runs the then mutation with the answer.

http.summary: Routes on the Deployment's own host for programs and other services: a JSON endpoint, a webhook, a file a program fetches. There is no browser call; the app's own pages keep using miniapp.actions.call, and may use a file's route as an img src.

seo.summary: Canonical addresses and page cards for HTML pages, robots.txt and a sitemap when the owner turns search listing on.

options.label: Canonical address
options.help: Choose the address search engines and link previews should use.

options.label: Card image
options.help: Choose an image path from the app's published files.
